responsibility: Supplies the Linux/ELF operating-system layer overrides for the TILEPro target. It defines preprocessor and linker specs, profiling and executable-stack conventions, the glibc stack-protector guard offset from the thread pointer, and the target-specific instruction-cache flush implementation or libgcc hook for __clear_cache, thereby adapting the generic TILEPro machine description to GNU/Linux runtime, TLS, profiling, and cache-management behavior.
